# moistari-rls-original — private source scout and frozen review

Fixed source: https://github.com/moistari/rls/tree/f84797726c6af8d64a228d9349832002c8f33888 (MIT).

407 raw records; 404 positive title assertions; 266 video-type positives (158 movie, 83 episode, 25 series). Exclude 141 non-video/unspecified records, 9 explicitly inventoried placeholder or unestablished metadata stress inputs, and 4 subtitle/cover/audio-test/software payloads. Remaining raw positive title capacity: 253. This is an assertion census, not full annotation coverage.

The census compared a 646-entry gold snapshot: 61 qualified exact input overlaps and 192 qualified inputs outside gold. Existing imported JSON sources overlap 69 qualified inputs, leaving 184 outside those sources. The ajarsnuggle/rls scout fork overlaps 404/407 raw inputs (263/266 video): it is the same source family, not independent corroboration. Exact overlap evidence is in the sibling overlap JSON; original indices and raw labels are in the inventory and literals JSONL.

Authorship/dataflow: TestParseRelease compares actual parsed values against literal test.exp loaded from tests.yaml. TestExport_tests sorts and writes those same expected values, without parsing inputs to generate them. The separate scanner scripts do not generate tests.yaml. Preserved original Git blobs match the fixed commit. The checkout has only shallow history, so unseen prehistory and ultimate manual authorship cannot be proven. No upstream parser, tests, scanner, generator or exporter was run.

Forty novel-to-gold movie inputs were individually audited before the first parser probe. Every entry records raw input/title line numbers, the original label map, a specific rationale, and the complete identity/coverage/confidence/seven-field quality contract. SHA-256 of the preprobe audit: a28fe992f5aabab8b604b2e5949ebeed7b35d288a55a200cf0817ea0bb8e64ac. It has not been changed after testing. Index 68 explicitly rejects the upstream 1080p normalization because its raw input says 1080i; the unsupported resolution stays unknown.

Actual TestReviewedFullReleaseAnnotations, in a private scratch Go overlay: 40 subtests executed, 28 passed and 12 failed. Complete failures remain unchanged in probe-attempt3.jsonl and the sibling probe-summary JSON. Attempt 1 failed the scratch source allowlist before comparison; attempt 2 failed an unrelated PTT global-gold precondition. Attempt 3 binds only moistari's provenance gate, source lookup, source path and 40-entry census in the copied actual test. Existing per-row source contradiction checks and all title/year/type/coverage/quality/confidence/version comparisons remain active. These results do not claim the global gold suite passes.

Source manifest/inventory: reviewed_entries=0 and all acceptance/authority/coverage/unit-authorization flags=false. Forty private audits and 28 passing comparisons do not change those counts or flags. Shared registry, shared gold, parser code/version, Java and Beast helper were not edited. Only the new private moistari_literal_source_test.go helper was added.

Retained runnable overlay: /data/temp/pulse-m3-complete.AixjUd/moistari-rls-original/overlay.json. The copied test reads its frozen scratch corpus explicitly, because Go build overlays do not redirect runtime os.ReadFile. After using mise's pinned Go 1.26.9, run go test -overlay=<that path> ./internal/domain/media -run '^(TestReviewedFullReleaseAnnotations|TestMoistariOriginalSourceRemainsUnreviewed)$' -count=1 -json with TMPDIR/TMP/TEMP/GOCACHE/GOMODCACHE/GOPATH set inside a new owned /data/temp directory. Expected outcome is failure with the 12 retained mismatches; do not alter expected values to make it pass.
